interaction_rules.predict_fill: Tap an answer (it presses down 2 px and outlines); Check enables; Check shows the result sheet with the robot; a right answer earns bolts and a notebook entry; a wrong answer shakes, plays its own picture consequence, and offers Try again.
interaction_rules.fix: Tap a line (green "given" lines cannot be picked); the other lines fold away; pick a replacement from that line's options; tap the line again to unfold. Lines with no options say "Line N looks right. Tap another line."
interaction_rules.code_numbering: Predict and Fill code starts at display.first_line_number; when display.earlier_note is set, one grey row shows it above the code.
interaction_rules.checkpoints: Navy page; no hints and no notes; options each in their own colour with a cream outline; recap turns green with confetti and announces "Checkpoint complete".
interaction_rules.reduced_motion: Every animation stops; pictures jump to their final state; device screens show their final reading.

future_chat_hook.trigger_suggested: tapping the robot on the result sheet after a wrong answer
future_chat_hook.data: Each question has ai_context: the question, code, earlier lines, right answer and why, the takeaway, and why each wrong answer is wrong.
